name: Commerce Open Payment Platform: webhooks
description: Optional submodule of Commerce Open Payment Platform: exposes the /opp/webhooks endpoint that receives OPPWA server-to-server payment notifications, decrypts them with AES-256-GCM, and finalizes payments asynchronously via Advanced Queue.
project_description: Webhooks support for Open Payment Platform payment gateway. Submodule of the commerce_opp project. Provides a single public endpoint at /opp/webhooks that receives OPPWA (ACI PAY.ON) PAYMENT and TEST notifications as AES-256-GCM encrypted payloads, verifies and decrypts them with the encryption secret configured on the parent module, and enqueues an Advanced Queue job to apply the resulting payment/order state transition.
